topic: Kids with the highest "speed" move first.
text: Prioritize increasing your character's "speed" stat to ensure they act before others in turn-based battles.
Press B when the menu isn't up to see your move range before acting.
To throw a snowball, select "Snowball" from the "Action" menu.
If you select “No,” you will not rewatch the tutorial, so choose only if you genuinely need a refresher.
To access help for any command, select it and press SELECT.
